title: Dara is a professor who communicates the history, art and architecture with wit and passion.
text: Dara was recommended to us by a colleague and we were so pleased to have had her as our private guide to the Granada Cathedral and Royal Chapel. She made the historical building have context and substance. She is a very nice person who we were fortunate to have met and learn from. She gave the tour with wit and wisdom.
author: tinde

title: Amazing Guided Tour with Antonio V
text: Absolutely wonderful private guided tour with our guide Antonio V. of Granavision. Energetic, knowledgeable, passionate, and lovely. We give him our highest recommendation!
author: MiniAlbindiga

title: Antonio V -excellent walking tour of Granada
text: Antonio V was an excellent guide. Deeply steeped in historical knowledge, local customs, current culture, and insights into daily life
author: William I

title: The Best of Granada in a Day
text: My daughter and I spent a brilliant day with our wonderful tour guide Conchi seeing all the very best of Granada. The morning was spent in the old Moorish part of town, Albaicin. Every corner is a postcard and Conchi talked us through the amazing history of this area. A visit to the Royal Chapel and the Cathedral were also highlights of our morning - so many fascinating stories tied to this town. After a fab tapas lunch we ventured up to Generalife and to the Alhambra - so much beauty and history to soak in. Conchi was able to put it all in perspective for us and provided a wonderful commentar
author: Liza E

title: The tour company did not have our...
text: The tour company did not have our reservation. We called to confirm the day before, and after we finally convinced them we'd prepaid for a tour, they had to scramble to find us a guide. They also did not provide us with an air-conditioned van as promised because they had booked so many tours- and this created extra walking for an 80 year old in our group. I still give it 4 stars because the actual tour guide was fantastic!
author: Shari T

title: Saw a lot in a little amount of time...
